name: ARMAR-7
dof_breakdown: torque-controlled 8-DoF arms, underactuated five-finger hands, head, torso, holonomic mobile base
summary: KIT's assistive humanoid for homes and care facilities, the latest in the ARMAR family that began in 2000. It shares the ArmarX cognitive software with the industrial ARMAR-6 and has been shown opening doors, loading a dishwasher and handing objects to people (Automatica 2025, Hannover Messe 2026).
